title: Label each number in a list
objective: Put an if inside a loop so each item in a list gets its own answer.

body.text: An if can sit inside a repeat for each loop. The loop visits every item, and the if decides what to say for that item. Each item gets its own answer, so one list can produce several different lines.

body.title: Big or small
body.code:
make nums equal to a list of 3, 12, 7, 20
repeat for each n in nums
    if n is at least 20
        say "{n} is big"
    otherwise
        say "{n} is small"

body.prompt: The program labels every number small. Make it label 12 and 20 big and the rest small.
body.starter:
make nums equal to a list of 3, 12, 7, 20
repeat for each n in nums
    if n is at least 100
        say "{n} is big"
    otherwise
        say "{n} is small"
body.solution:
make nums equal to a list of 3, 12, 7, 20
repeat for each n in nums
    if n is at least 10
        say "{n} is big"
    otherwise
        say "{n} is small"

checks.description: It prints each number with big or small
